# Two-Step Alberta

> TwoStepAlberta.ca lists country and swing dances in small towns around Edmonton, Alberta: hall dances, cabarets, old-time country dances and monthly dances. Each listing has the date, start time, hall, band, price and a link to the event page. Red Deer-area dances are included, and Edmonton and St. Albert dances can be shown or hidden.

We only post public dances that a source shows with a date, a start time and a place. Listings are checked and updated every Wednesday, so always confirm details on the event's own page before you go.

## Pages

- [Hall dances](https://twostepalberta.ca/#dances): confirmed upcoming dances, soonest first
- [Expected dances](https://twostepalberta.ca/#expected): yearly dances whose next date isn't posted yet
- [Monthly dances](https://twostepalberta.ca/#monthly): regular weekly and monthly dances
- [About and contact](https://twostepalberta.ca/about/): what the site is for and how to reach us

## Feeds

- [Calendar feed (iCal)](https://twostepalberta.ca/dances.ics): every confirmed dance with times
- [RSS feed](https://twostepalberta.ca/feed.xml): one item per confirmed dance

## Add a dance

- [Submit a dance](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSvcJA_JO-SMhnt25zOBlzJMs5c-1fO8WIsBECea9QOfH4gw/viewform): organizers can send us a public dance to list
